title: Our University. Part 2: History
summary: Історія університету від 1784 року до 2007-го — і граматика, заради якої цей текст дали: майже всі речення в пасивному стані минулого часу (was opened, was renamed, was set up). Плюс синоніми з Task 2.

sections.heading: Tell about the history of the University. — Розкажи історію університету за датами.
sections.body:
In 1784 the chair of veterinary medicine was set up at the medical faculty of Lviv University.
In 1881 the veterinary school was opened in Lviv.
In 1896 it was renamed the Lviv Academy of Veterinary Medicine.
From 1939 it was the Veterinary Institute with one faculty.
In 1949 the second faculty was created — zootechnical (now Biology and Technology).
In 1991 the third faculty was created — sanitary-technological (now Food Technologies and Biotechnology).
In June 1992 the Academy regained its former name.
In 2002 the faculty of Economics and Management was opened.
In 2007 the Academy became the University.

sections.heading: Who were the first director and the first rector? Whose name does the University bear? — Хто був першим директором і ректором, чиє ім'я носить університет?
sections.body:
The first director of the veterinary school was professor Peter Seifman.
The first rector of the Academy was professor Joseph Spielman.
In 1994 the Academy received the name of its former student, the prominent scientist Stepan Gzhytskyi (1900–1976).

sections.heading: Чому в тексті переважає пасивний стан і як він утворюється?
sections.body:
Коли важлива дія, а не її виконавець, англійська ставить присудок у пасив: was opened, was renamed, was set up, was created.
Формула: was / were + Past Participle.
Саме про це питає Task 5: у тексті переважають пасивні конструкції, бо йдеться про те, що сталося з закладом, а не хто це зробив.
Виняток — активні речення з regained і received, де діяч названий.

sections.heading: Назви синоніми до слів з Task 2.
sections.body:

glorious — notable, remarkable
to rename — to change the name

glossary.definition: засновувати — to establish, to create, to open, to set up
was/were + Past Participle: was opened, was renamed

homework.prompt: Give synonyms: to found, glorious, to regain, former, prominent, a scientist.
homework.referenceAnswer: to found — to establish/create/open/set up; glorious — notable, remarkable; to regain — to receive back; former — previous; prominent — eminent, famous, celebrated; a scientist — a scholar.

homework.prompt: When was the veterinary school founded, and when did it become a University? Answer in full sentences.
homework.referenceAnswer: The veterinary school was opened in 1881; the department of veterinary medicine had been founded in 1784. In 2007 the Academy was renamed into the University.

homework.prompt: Task 3: поділи на правильні й неправильні та дай три форми — to be, to begin, to found, to open, to set up, to receive.
homework.referenceAnswer: Неправильні: to be — was/were — been; to begin — began — begun; to set — set — set. Правильні: to found — founded — founded; to open — opened — opened; to receive — received — received.

homework.prompt: Task 5: які конструкції переважають у тексті й чому? Наведи два приклади.
homework.referenceAnswer: Переважає пасивний стан: was opened, was renamed, was set up, was created. Так пишуть, коли важлива подія, а не виконавець дії.

homework.prompt: Переклади: у 1992 році вища школа повернула свою колишню назву.
homework.referenceAnswer: In 1992 the higher school regained its former name.
